texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Credit or Deduction
texts.text: Credit or Deduction

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Instead of taking the credit on Form 1116, you may choose to deduct foreign income taxes on Schedule A (Form 1040). Generally; if you take the credit for any allowable foreign taxes; you may not take any of that year's foreign tax as a deduction; either in the year you take the credit or in any later year. However, you may take a deduction for foreign taxes not allowed as a credit because of boycott provisions; even if you have taken the credit for other foreign taxes for the year. You may also deduct taxes to certain foreign countries for which a credit has been denied under section 901()(2), even if you take the credit for other foreign taxes. part paid
